data.narrative:
Forterra is a Series B-stage defense and security company that has raised $228M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—all operating in the Defense & Security sector at similar stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, which applies a typical 1.9x step-up multiplier from Series B onwards to the $228M capital raised proxy, yields an implied valuation of $433M. Peer-median benchmarking across 7 same-sector, same-stage private comparables—including Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B)—establishes a median peer valuation of $1.0B, with a observed range of $300M to $3.0B.

The two methods produce a triangulated valuation range of $368M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median implied value of $717M. This wide 3x spread reflects material dispersion within the peer cohort and uncertainty around Forterra's competitive positioning relative to Dream Security and other high-valued peers. Key variables affecting placement within this range include revenue scale, technology differentiation, customer concentration, and contract pipeline depth relative to the median-valued comparables.
